note: Hand transcription of tactics.tools/info/items (read 2026-10-20; numbers match 18.2). Items changed in 18.3/18.4 carry the official values and the notes as a source. Effect texts are short paraphrases, not Riot's wording. AP is stored as a number. older_copy_check compares with the older-set entry of the same item in the game-file export (values there can be outdated): equal stats support the transcription, differences need a look.
